example_semantic_review.Welford: Author new native Python from the independent population mean/variance specification; no historical origin is asserted. FP32 input, two BF16 scalar outputs at address zero, symbolic row length/stride, and full original per-program IO/frame remain. Replace non-native toReal with explicit integer-to-FP32 conversions of the actual index and uint64 count tensor. Re-prove execution of the actual loop, both statistics, both stores, safety and frame. Existing count limit and all numerical scalar/schedule conditions remain; guards are rebound to actual FP32-loaded values. The independent Real target remains unchanged, including its totalized empty-row case. FP keeps nonempty and certified count bounds. No new numerical rules.
example_semantic_review.FusedLayerNorm: Author new native Python from the independent affine population-variance specification; no historical origin is asserted. Both FP32 input passes, gamma/beta reads, epsilon, sqrt/reciprocal, operation order and BF16 output remain visible. Re-prove both complete programs, successful execution, all active output cells, source safety and exact exterior frame. Reuse the actual Welford source loop through a complete-body equality, without a source-generating macro. Every numerical condition concerns the actual FP32-loaded row; the count bound is retained. Empty rows still execute and preserve every cell under every algebra, with no arithmetic condition. Independent Real formulas and all public hypotheses are unchanged.
